ownership.bus: The caller retains its existing IMessageBus; the control does not replace or own it.
ownership.payloadLifetime: The caller owns each item until its synchronous public emission returns or throws; no item is retained.
ownership.managedReferences: The control accepts the same managed references as the ordinary public call and stores none.
ownership.alignment: Managed payload layout follows the existing public message type; no native arena is used.
ownership.reclamation: No new holder exists; existing bus and token cleanup remains per ordinary call.

topology.threadAffinity: The existing bus owner thread performs each synchronous emission.
topology.playerLoopPhase: The caller's current phase; the control does not schedule a later phase.

ordering.linearizationPoint: Each ordinary public emission call is a separate boundary in input order.

lifecycle.reset: A reset during item n takes effect before item n+1 exactly as in repeated calls.
lifecycle.cancellation: Only the ordinary per-item cancellation contract applies; no batch cancellation state exists.
lifecycle.disposal: Disposal during item n follows the public call contract; later items see the disposed state.
lifecycle.exceptions: The original exception propagates from item n without wrapping; later items are not called.
lifecycle.producerAbandon: No reservation exists; stopping before an item publishes nothing for that item.
lifecycle.partialPublication: Completed earlier items remain observable; no rollback or deferred publication occurs.

decision.workload: Same-route batches of 1, 4, 16, 64, 128, and 256 calls after prewarm; measurement waits for #510 and #512.
decision.p99: N/A until #512 effective-sample rules and open-loop load exist
decision.retainedMemory: pending allocation and holder checks after semantic RED
decision.playerSize: pending optional prototype build; no production surface is added
decision.buildTime: pending optional prototype build; no production surface is added
decision.stopRule: Stop on any per-item trace mismatch or leaked holder; do not promote below the 20% workload gain without a distinct supported capability.
